description: This file defines a base class 'Formatter' used for converting parsed content blocks into structured documents such as table of contents and indices, within a documentation generation context.

classes.name: Formatter
classes.description: A base class for formatting structured documentation from content blocks, including methods for handling table of contents, indices, and sections.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Formatter with a processor, setting up identifiers, chapters, sections, and block index.

methods.name: add_identifier
methods.description: Adds a name and block to the identifiers dictionary, warning if duplicate.

methods.name: toc_dump
methods.description: Generates the table of contents and index files, calling relevant methods for each chapter and section.

methods.name: index_dump
methods.description: Generates the index file based on block index.

methods.name: section_dump
methods.description: Outputs a section's content, including blocks and fields, to a file.
